name: Signal Cluster S16: Crossover, Crossunder & Momentum Confirmation
description: Tests: crossover, crossunder, crossany, rising(length), falling(length). Verifies pulse signal generation, momentum confirmation patterns, and volume-confirmed momentum.
source:
# =============================================================================
# SIGNAL CLUSTER S16: Crossover / Crossunder / Rising / Falling
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c
volume = src.v

# === INDICATORS ===
sma_50 = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(close)
sma_200 = ma(period=200, type=MAType.sma)(close)
rsi_val = rsi(close, 14)

# === SIGNAL GENERATION ===
# MA crossover/crossunder (pulse signals)
golden_cross = crossover(close, sma_200)
death_cross = crossunder(close, sma_200)
any_cross = crossany(close, sma_200)

# RSI threshold crossings
rsi_overbought = crossover(rsi_val, 70)
rsi_oversold = crossunder(rsi_val, 30)

# Momentum confirmation — rising/falling
rising_3 = rising(close, length=3)
falling_3 = falling(close, length=3)

# Volume-confirmed momentum
rising_vol = rising(volume, length=2)
strong_bull = rising_3 and rising_vol

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Price & SMA',
    category='Signal',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Close', color=Color.White),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SMA 50', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SMA 200', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(close, sma_50, sma_200))

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.ArrowUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Close', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='SMA 200', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title='Golden Cross'
    )
)((close, sma_200, golden_cross))

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Close', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='Volume', dp=0, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title='Strong Bullish (3-bar rise + volume)'
    )
)((close, volume, strong_bull))
